description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the TopicPath interface, representing a structured topic path with various components such as namespace, entity name, group, channel, criterion, and optional parts like actions, search actions, and subjects. It provides factory methods for creating instances with different parameter combinations and overrides methods for equality, string representation, and path building.

classes.name: ImmutableTopicPath
classes.description: A final, immutable class implementing TopicPath, encapsulating the data and behavior related to topic paths used within the system.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create ImmutableTopicPath instances with different parameters: for path with just namespace, entity name, group, channel, and criterion; with an action; with a subject; with a search action.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component of the topic path.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group component of the topic path.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel component of the topic path.

methods.name: getCriterion
methods.description: Returns the criterion component of the topic path.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the action if present.

methods.name: getSearchAction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the search action if present.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the subject if present.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the full string path representation.
